name: Joe Kunkle
zh_summary: @OptionsHawk says $KVYO November $17.5 calls are set to open sharply higher on a sympathy move with $BRZE, attaching his Sept. 23 post: Klaviyo saw nearly 30,000 call contracts over two sessions versus a usual average under 1,300 a day, short interest rose to 7.5% of float from 3.5% in May, and shares were down 48.5% YTD.
